mentions.name: Taiso Speaker
mentions.description: This is a dedicated speaker for Radio Taiso, playing daily calisthenics routines synced with music. It is built around an ESP32 with custom PCBs and a 3D-printed enclosure, and features remote firmware updates, an embedded website, and streamlined Wi-Fi setup.
mentions.source_excerpt: I really like Radio Taiso (daily calisthenics synced with music), so I made a dedicated speaker (https://www.taisospkr.com).
